why: check-budgets.ts is touched by 137 commits and every wave raised a ceiling with a comment; 95 of 124 values named argo. Split per area and ratchet down only.
what: scripts/check-budgets.ts becomes a thin entry over scripts/check-budgets/ with one rows file per area, the provider-only fixture row, and a base-branch ratchet. New files: check-budgets/{index.ts,ratchet.ts,areas/*.ts}.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/quality-contract.md section 6 (method, rows), 12 (I1 first, before fan-out) and docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 10 (ratchet). Keep scripts/check-budgets.ts and the exports runBudgets and isOwnGraphId so root pre, CI and check-budgets.test.ts keep working. No ceiling is raised; PROVIDER_ONLY keeps its value until spike-provider sets it. Existing rows are keyed by metric, not area, so areas are the lanes that edit them: surface (value symbols non-chart, barrel types, subpaths), charts (chart symbols, chart size rows), provider (PROVIDER_ONLY, dev chunks, embedded, feature chunks, theme-only), agent (rule lines), docs (spec prose), playground (route files), cli (CLI lines), gates (the consumer, peer and surface gate rows). Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so.
exemplar: Existing rows and label order in check-budgets.ts; check-budgets.test.ts for the tested seam.
change: Create scripts/check-budgets/{index.ts,ratchet.ts,areas/<area>.ts}; index discovers area files by directory scan (a new lane adds its own file, never edits index); move each existing row whole into its area file with its current ceiling. Ratchet: compare each area file with `git show origin/master:<file>`; a higher ceiling needs a row {ceiling, from, to, consumer, repo} where repo is in scripts/fleet.json rows and is not argo. Fail closed with 'fleet.json missing' only when a raised ceiling needs that lookup (no raise, no failure, so make check passes before fleet.json lands); tests use a fixture. Ships with: the ratchet as the rule, no skill snippet, tests in check-budgets.test.ts.
commits: One PR; package and non-package changes are separate commits (isolated-basalt-ui hook; root package.json, bun.lock, .oxlintrc.json, tests/ may ride with the package commit). Conventional, empty scope, no attribution, never CHANGELOG.md.
proof: bun run check-budgets output order and values identical before and after the split.
acceptance: bun run check-budgets prints the same rows, values and ceilings as on origin/master (diff of the two outputs is empty).
scripts/check-budgets.ts is under 60 lines and re-exports runBudgets and isOwnGraphId.

Tests: a raised ceiling with no row fails; with a row naming a fleet repo passes; a row naming argo fails; a lowered ceiling passes; no base file passes; a raise with no fleet.json fails closed with 'fleet.json missing'.
A test adds areas/zz-fixture.ts to a temp copy and index picks it up with no edit to index.ts or ratchet.ts.
out_of_scope: Setting new ceilings, the playground route ceiling of 8 (set when the playground reset lands), provider value, v3 byte fixtures.
